title: Super Real Mahjong Graffiti
native_title: スーパーリアル麻雀 グラフィティ
overview:
Super Real Mahjong Graffiti gathers three of Seta's adult arcade mahjong games on one disc: Super Real Mahjong PII, PIII and PIV. Each is a one-on-one game of strip mahjong, and the collection is rated for adults only.

Six opponents wait across the table:
- Syouko, from PII
- Kasumi and Miki Serizawa, from PIII
- Sisters Mana, Yuu and Kaori, from PIV
